test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of revenue receipt in the government budget?

options.text: Repayment of a loan by a state - owned company
Dividends received from a state - owned enterprise

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dividends received from a state-owned enterprise**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dividends received from a state-owned enterprise** are classified as a revenue receipt in the government budget.
 
• Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government. They are non-redeemable and do not create any liabilities.
 
• These include tax revenues like income tax, corporate tax, and non-tax revenues such as dividends and profits from public sector enterprises.
 
• Revenue receipts are crucial for the government as they help in meeting its day-to-day expenditures without increasing its liabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sale of government-owned land** and **borrowing money from international organizations** are capital receipts as they either create liabilities or reduce assets.
 
• **Repayment of a loan by a state-owned company** is also a capital receipt as it affects the financial assets of the government.
 
• Understanding the distinction between revenue and capital receipts helps in analyzing the financial health and fiscal policies of the government.
